meta.name: PA
meta.description: PA — migrated verbatim from tools/material_db.json (typical desktop-FDM datasheet-class values) plus the heat-set pull-out table from joint_check.py. Poisson is a typical thermoplastic value (absent from material_db). Thermal-transport fields are null: not present in the migrated source, not invented.

sn_curve.note: engineering rule of thumb (~1e6-cycle allowable = ultimate x knockdown), NOT a measured S-N curve

anisotropy.model: scalar-tier direction heuristic (production_check.py): across-layer (Z) tensile strength / in-plane (XY) strength; applied when the primary load is > threshold deg out of the layer plane

heatset_pullout_n.note: brass knurled heat-set at standard insert length; conservative low ends (joint_check.py)

sources.mechanical.poisson: typical thermoplastic (material_db.json has no poisson); provided for FEA
sources._db_source_note: typical printed-nylon (PA6/PA12 blends, e.g. Polymaker PA6-CF matrix / Taulman) DRY-as-printed values; moisture conditioning can HALVE yield and modulus — treat these as dry-part numbers and verify conditioned.
sources.thermal.conductivity_w_mk: 0.25 W/mK, conservative-low of the desktop-nylon band 0.24-0.30 (dry as molded): Professional Plastics chart PA6 0.24-0.28 / PA66 0.25 @23 C https://www.professionalplastics.com/professionalplastics/ThermalPropertiesofPlasticMaterials.pdf ; neat PA12 measured 0.28 @30 C https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC8840078/ ; Ensinger TECAMID 12 0.30 https://www.ensingerplastics.com/en/shapes/products/pa12-tecamid-12-natural
sources.thermal.specific_heat_j_kgk: 1700 J/kgK @RT (dry): Professional Plastics PA6 1700 / PA66 1670 https://www.professionalplastics.com/professionalplastics/ThermalPropertiesofPlasticMaterials.pdf ; PA12 1.7 J/g-C https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC8840078/ ; Ensinger PA12 1.8 J/gK. Moisture-conditioned nylon runs higher — TDS values are dry-as-molded
sources.thermal.tg_or_melt_c: left null DELIBERATELY: this is a generic desktop-nylon record and Tg is subtype-dependent — PA12 37 C (Ensinger https://www.ensingerplastics.com/en/shapes/products/pa12-tecamid-12-natural), PA6 ~60 C, Polymaker CoPA 67 C DSC (https://wiki.polymaker.com/polymaker-products/more-about-our-products/documents/technical-data-sheets/nylon/polymide-tm-copa). One number would misstate somebody's spool; see softening_c for the conservative design floor
sources.thermal.softening_c: softening_c = conservative softening allowable for sustained-load design: the LOW end of min(Tg, HDT-B 0.45 MPa) across cited brand TDS values for this material class (degC). PA: 37 C = LOWEST plausible subtype Tg (PA12; CoPA/PA6 sit at 60-67 C — never average across variants, design to the reported extreme). Nylon MUST be gated on Tg, not HDT: semicrystalline HDT-B (~130-200 C molded, Professional Plastics chart) stays high while stiffness collapses above Tg; neat printed desktop-nylon HDT-B is effectively unpublished (CoPA TDS omits it)
sources.thermal._printed_anisotropy_note: printed parts conduct WORSE than bulk, direction-dependent: inter-layer thermal contact resistance dominates through-thickness conduction (Prajapati et al., Additive Manufacturing 2018, https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S2214860417305456); voids/porosity measurably reduce heat transmission even at 100% infill (Entropy 24:654 2022, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9141791/); through-plane k reported ~20-40% below in-plane in FDM literature (secondary synthesis, primaries paywalled — treat percentage as indicative). Records store the conservative-LOW isotropic value.
sources.thermal._cp_temperature_note: cp is strongly temperature-dependent (amorphous polymers jump +30-50% crossing Tg; Covestro shows TPU cp +~15% from 20C to 80C) — record values are ROOM-TEMPERATURE-class unless noted
